title: How he got the nickname Ram and first sat in with Kid Ory
summary: Hall explains the nickname Kid Ory gave him and how he first played with Ory at St. Catherine Hall, substituting for Ory's drummer Henry Martin.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Alright, let's go ahead. Do you want to give me a name first? Well, my right name is Minor Hall. And as far as this rhyme is concerned, Kid already gave me that nickname.

Yeah, he did. When I first started out, I was so fast to start the playing, even before he'd knock off a number. That's what we used to do in Yorling, you know, that stomp off. So, first he called me a round of go, because I was always ready. That's where the first of it started. That was back in New Orleans. Yeah, that was in Yorling's. When I first played with Oren, and how that happened was his drummer, a fellow by the name of Henry Martin, I don't remember him. I never knew him but he was. I used to go down to St. Catherine Hall where they played on Sunday night, and sat in one night, and I played so much like him. In other words, the rhythm. And so, his drummer laid off one night, and Oren had me to work in his place. And I played so well like him, so close to him, until Oren, until Oren hired me several times to play in his place when he couldn't make it. So, after that, my brother, Tubby Hall, he really gave me my face starting the playing. Now, who was the oldest? Tubby was. Tubby was older. Tubby was older. Yeah, yeah. He was two years older than me.
